flag_descriptions.tensor_parallel_size=4: Topology validated on 4×B200 SXM (183 GB each, NV18 full mesh), TP=4 — 2727 nonces/min per instance; two instances per 8-GPU node.
flag_descriptions.VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP8=1: FlashInfer MoE FP8 path for the native-FP8 GLM-5.3-Flash checkpoint; baked into the image env.
flag_descriptions.VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_MOE_FP4=1: FlashInfer MoE FP4 kernels enabled in the image env (no-op for the FP8 checkpoint; relevant only if an NVFP4 requant is mounted).
flag_descriptions.POC_BATCH_SIZE=32: PoC batch forced by the image to 32 for this GPU (validated 2026-09-13 on the 3.1.0 base with gonka-poc plugin v0.1.6, which fixes the first-nonce-in-batch artefact).
